status: research taxonomy; not an implemented support claim
scope: Professional documents and associated working files. Families are extensible; recipient-prescribed and specialist formats retain their own requirements.

families.name: Executive decisions and briefings
families.job: Help a busy reader understand an issue and decide or act.
families.layout: Compact first-page masthead, continuous flow, short sections, no automatic cover or contents page.
checks: one-page request met without dropping text or shrinking body type

families.name: Business planning and strategy
families.job: Explain choices, evidence, resources, economics and execution.
families.layout: Readable chapter flow, selective section openers, navigable contents for long plans, separate financial schedules.

families.name: Board and corporate governance
families.job: Prepare, record or retrieve decisions under named authority.
structure: recorded decisions and actions only when supplied
families.layout: Restrained numbered papers, pack index, clear item boundaries, page-of-total and approval areas where appropriate.
checks: pack index and page references work

families.name: Investor communication and diligence
families.job: Let a reader evaluate the business and trace statements to evidence.
families.layout: Light, calm reading surface, restrained amber accents, evidence tables and linked appendices; no paper grain.

families.name: Research and evidence reports
families.job: Explain a question, method, evidence, findings and limitations.
families.layout: Sustained reading typography, numbered figures and tables, citations and footnotes, optional long-document contents.
formats: JATS only for a validated publisher workflow
checks: equations either supported or rejected explicitly

families.name: Technical and product documentation
families.job: Help specialists build, integrate, verify or understand a system.
families.layout: Numbered navigable sections, exact code blocks, diagrams with text equivalents, wide schema tables and stable anchors.

families.name: Proposals and scoped work
families.job: Explain the offered outcome, bounded work, cost and acceptance.
families.layout: Client-facing opening, milestone and deliverable tables, clear commercial summary, restrained acceptance block.

families.name: Commercial, pricing and procurement files
families.job: Make a purchase, offer or payment understandable and traceable.
structure: validity or due date when supplied
families.layout: Tabular priority, aligned numerical columns, visible totals and conditions, limited decoration.
formats: UBL XML only through a validated trading workflow
checks: e-invoice compliance not inferred from a PDF

families.name: Agreements and legal instruments
families.job: Enable precise review, negotiation and execution of supplied legal text.
families.layout: Conventional black-on-white legal typography, restrained or absent branding, preserved clause numbering, dependable indentation and signature space.
formats: PDF for review or execution copy
checks: formatting is not legal review or e-signature

families.name: Formal correspondence
families.job: Deliver a direct message to an identified recipient.
families.layout: Block letter by default, compact letterhead, no separate cover or table of contents.
formats: HTML or plain text when delivered as correspondence

families.name: Operating procedures and controlled documents
families.job: Help someone perform a repeatable task correctly and record completion.
structure: owner and approved version when supplied
families.layout: Task-focused headings, numbered steps, checklists and decision tables, visible control metadata.
checks: revision and effective-date fields are distinct

families.name: Project delivery and coordination
families.job: Coordinate ownership, dependencies, progress and exceptions.
families.layout: Compact management report plus structured working register; avoid a prose page for every status row.
checks: snapshot and live register clearly identified

families.name: Financial models and analytical workbooks
families.job: Let users inspect assumptions, calculate outcomes and test scenarios.
families.layout: Workbook-native cells and formulas, explicit units, readable numbers, minimal merges, separate presentation sheets from data tables.
checks: no external workbook dependencies by default

families.name: People and professional records
families.job: Communicate responsibilities, experience or an authorized personnel process.
families.layout: Role-appropriate readable hierarchy; chronology for CVs, question-and-record layout for interviews, controlled policy flow for handbooks.
checks: form layout does not authorize an employment decision

families.name: Learning and enablement
families.job: Teach a skill or support recall during work.
families.layout: Distinct lesson and reference modes, space for exercises when requested, clear sequences and examples.
formats: EPUB for a validated book workflow

families.name: Case studies and editorial communication
families.job: Communicate a useful story or proposition with attributable evidence.
families.layout: Editorial pacing, selective visuals, evidence captions; case studies show a time-bound before/after, fact sheets prioritize lookup.
checks: decorative imagery never treated as evidence

families.name: Presentations and slide documents
families.job: Support a spoken narrative or a self-contained visual reading sequence.
families.layout: Separate 16:9 slide geometry; live-talk and reading-deck density differ. Use native editable shapes, text, charts and tables where supported.
checks: text readable at actual presentation size
existing investor deck remains a separate surface

families.name: Forms, questionnaires and acknowledgements
families.job: Collect specified information or an acknowledgement with clear field meaning.
families.layout: Field-first, generous input space, sensible tab order and explicit labels. A printable blank form and an interactive form are different deliverables.
formats: fillable PDF only with an implemented AcroForm adapter
checks: signature line not represented as an executed signature

families.name: Recipient-prescribed and specialist documents
families.job: Satisfy the exact current recipient or governing format.
families.layout: Recipient template controls geometry, fields and numbering; brand customization only when permitted.
checks: all required fields and attachments accounted for
no unsupported legal or clinical content generation
no claim of universal submission support

families.name: Books, manuals and long publications
families.job: Support sustained reading and repeated navigation across a large work.
families.layout: Book-specific pagination, navigation and front/back matter; reflowable reading and fixed print editions handled separately.
formats: EPUB after packaging and reading-system validation

families.name: Data packages, registers and schedules
families.job: Allow accurate lookup, filtering, transfer or reconciliation.
families.layout: One record per row in working data; display tables can group information without corrupting the underlying dataset.
